features.label: Old town sweeping bend
features.subject: A long, generously wide cobbled street curving in a graceful irregular S from upper left to lower right, widening into a small bulge halfway along. Tight rows of small blue-grey granite setts follow the curve with beautiful fan-shaped repairs, a narrow drainage gutter and individually chipped raised curb stones on both sides. Visible shallow vertical curb faces and a few roots, moss seams, sparse wisps of grass along the outside. Street occupies most of the image; no large terrain base. Both open road ends continue off naturally with uneven overlapping cobble teeth, not rounded end caps.

features.label: Old canal arch bridge
features.subject: A substantial diagonal stone bridge running upper left to lower right, generously wide walkable blue-grey cobblestone deck, beautifully built weathered masonry arch facing the viewer, deep visible vertical stonework under the deck, sturdy low parapets, four squat square dressed-stone pier posts. Include the complete single broad arch and both open road approach ends with irregular overlapping cobble teeth. Dark moss near the bottom courses, fine mortar, chipped coping, subtle varied stones. Transparent empty space through and under the arch, no water baked in. No lamps, people or buildings. Same perspective and level of intricate stonework as the bridge in the reference.

features.label: Asymmetric market fork
features.subject: A broad asymmetric three-way cobbled street junction: a broad road enters from lower right and forks into a narrow alley toward upper right and a generous street toward upper left. Sweeping curved triangular space between branches, NO island or central prop. Individual small granite setts turn with each branch, several patches of replaced smaller stone, raised chipped curb with shallow visible front face, carved drainage channels. An organic authored junction, not a symmetrical T or diagram. All three road ends OPEN and end in uneven overlapping cobble teeth. Absolutely no stairs. A very shallow layer of street only, no thick rock plinth.

features.label: Long diagonal lane
features.subject: A long blue-grey cobbled village street running diagonally from lower left to upper right at the SAME diagonal angle as reference ground edges. It has irregular gently wavering sides, a short widened doorstep pocket on one side, gutters, richly varied patched fan-pattern paving, small moss tufts, shallow raised curbs with visible vertical stone faces. Both road ends OPEN, end in uneven overlapping cobble teeth. A thin ground-level street cutout, no thick plinth. Sharp intricate cobbles visible in their hundreds.

features.label: Uneven market square
features.subject: An irregular five-sided gently elongated village market plaza seen in the reference's oblique ground plane, fan-pattern blue-grey cobbled paving, a lovely large worn circular stone mosaic off-center, contrasting repaired patches, drainage channels and shallow dressed stone curbs along some sides, three broad open approach gaps at upper-left, upper-right and lower-right. No central fountain, no buildings, no stalls, no objects. Detailed empty plaza ground ready to decorate independently. Ground plane is visibly foreshortened into a low broad shape, NOT an overhead pentagon or circle. No thick plinth.

features.label: Long stone quay
features.subject: A long diagonal stone canal bank running upper left to lower right. Broad cobbled walkway behind a low stone coping, a DEEP exposed vertical retaining wall on the foreground side, two understated buttresses, a tiny round drain mouth, dark mossy lower courses, chipped masonry capstones. The view and stonework match the reference canal banks exactly. No water, no lamps, no railings, no buildings, no furniture; only the strip of quay pavement and its retaining wall, isolated. Open road connections at both ends; no thick floating island plinth behind it. Rich precise dressed stone detail.

features.label: Rounded projecting quay
features.subject: A beautiful outward-bulging curved stone canal bank and narrow cobbled promenade, forming a substantial convex quarter-curve from upper left to upper right via the lower foreground. The front shows a deep continuous vertical retaining wall following the curve, weathered blocks, buttress at the middle, dark moss at bottom, coping stones on top. Paved walkway on top curves alongside the bank and has open road ends at both ends. Transparent area on both sides of the strip; no water, no land base, no props or buildings. It must read as a curved vertical waterfront wall and pavement, not an overhead curved tile.

features.label: Indented canal corner
features.subject: An inward-bending L-shaped stone canal retaining wall with cobbled promenade on top, making a deep concave recessed waterfront corner. Two diagonal arms join in an inner corner; their tall vertical faces both visible in the recess and follow the reference 2.5D perspective. Thick weathered stone coping, battered bottom blocks, moss and small drain grate at the corner, a few sparse wall ferns. No water, no lamps, no buildings or props. Transparent outside and inside the inlet. The piece contains just the open-ended narrow L promenade and its vertical masonry, not a giant square ground tile.

features.label: Watergate landing steps
features.subject: A small detailed stone watergate landing integrated into a short stretch of canal wall, broad stone steps descend diagonally toward lower left from an upper cobbled quay to a low rectangular landing by water level. Strong visible vertical retaining-wall faces on each side, low sturdy stone side walls with chipped capstones. Worn treads, drainage groove, dark moss near lowest step. NO actual water, no lamps, no buildings, no boats; fully independent transparent terrain feature. Upper pavement has an open road approach. Exact view and blue-grey masonry of reference.

features.label: Broad hillside stair street
features.subject: An authored stone stair street: wide generous flight of seven shallow worn steps descending toward lower right from upper left, with a broad cobbled upper landing and an uneven small lower landing. Low broken-in raised curbs and subtle visible masonry side wall, beautiful small-sett fan pattern on landings and narrow gutters, restrained moss. Both landings have open street connections. No railings, buildings, lamps or other props; isolate stairs and paved landings only, without thick rock island. Match reference camera exactly, visible steps and vertical faces, not a top-down stair diagram.

features.label: Winding garden flagstones
features.subject: A winding garden footpath of broad irregular blue-grey flagstones and small cobble infill, running lower left to upper right, visible foreshortened ground-plane perspective matching reference. Width varies organically, a weathered low curb on one side, the other edge broken with a few stones tapering into tiny sparse moss tufts. Shallow chipped stone edges catch light. A distinct authored S curve, not a regular repeated tile. Open ends, no lamps, no large plants, no surrounding ground rectangle, no thick platform.

features.label: Angled timber landing
features.subject: An irregular old wooden waterside landing with an angled short gangway approaching from upper left, widened asymmetric deck on the right, a low step, uneven weathered oak planks following perspective, tall slim supporting timber pilings and visible cross braces underneath, a small coil of rope attached to one piling. Entire isolated wood structure, no water, boats, buildings or lamps. Rich fine timber grain, small iron fasteners, restrained cool brown weathering harmonized with reference blue-grey village. No railings enclosing the usable walkway. Match reference's elevated orthographic camera and painted rendering.

features.label: Broad bridgehead terrace
features.subject:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution transparent terrain cutout for an editable 2.5D village game.
Input image 1 is the exact art direction and elevated three-quarter orthographic camera reference. Input image 2 is an existing bridge that must connect to this new quay; match its fine blue-grey stone scale, camera and lighting.
Generate ONE broad irregular waterside cobblestone terrace, substantially wider than a narrow path. Its water-facing FRONT edge runs from LOWER LEFT to UPPER RIGHT (southwest to northeast). Along that edge show a deep, beautifully detailed vertical masonry retaining face facing the viewer/bottom right, descending below the cobbled walking level. The large empty buildable paved terrace lies BEHIND that edge, toward UPPER LEFT. Make an asymmetrical elongated quadrilateral terrace, about twice as wide as its foreshortened depth. A large OPEN BRIDGE APPROACH gap halfway along the front parapet, no steps across the opening; an independent NW-to-SE bridge will overlap here later. Low coping and squat stone posts on either side of this 25%-of-edge-width gap. Other edges open into streets with irregular cobble teeth, not a solid raised island block. Dense worn granite setts with repaired fan paving, fine mortar, chipped coping, faint moss and drainage spouts. Hundreds of small stones, same intricate detail as reference. No buildings, no people, no objects, no water, no surrounding land. Only the pavement and visible front retaining wall; actual transparent background all around. Maintain 3/4 perspective, not overhead. Highest available native resolution, 2048x2048 requested, crisp production game art; do not add text or a checkerboard.

features.label: Compass market landing
features.subject: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high resolution transparent game terrain cutout. The reference screenshot defines the game's elevated three-quarter orthographic camera, detailed blue-grey cobbles and masonry. Create ONE broad asymmetrical quayside market landing, an empty paved terrace, with a small worn circular compass mosaic toward its right half. Its BACK edge runs diagonally from LOWER LEFT to UPPER RIGHT. A wide bridge approaches this BACK edge from UPPER LEFT and leaves the terrace toward LOWER RIGHT: leave a very broad clear opening halfway along the back parapet for that bridge to join. The terrace extends toward LOWER RIGHT from that opening. Make the shape irregular and generous, with a curved front-right corner and two open roads exiting at lower left and lower right, staggered cobble teeth on those road ends. Strongly foreshortened ground plane, NOT overhead. Low blue-grey stone parapets only on water-facing back boundary on either side of the large entrance gap, shallow curbs elsewhere, minimal visible low front foundation masonry, no massive plinth. Beautiful fan-pattern patched granite paving, hundreds of individually chipped small stones, faint moss in joints, channel gutters. No steps at the bridge gap; all paving is level. No water, no ground, no buildings, no props, no plants except faint moss, no text. Genuine transparent background. Native 2048x2048 requested. Crisp detailed illustrated fantasy game art with the exact reference camera.

features.label: Flush compass paving inlay
features.subject: Coplanar stone compass mosaic, three-quarter perspective, without raised edges.
